nodes.name: C001
nodes.rule: Core CLI commands must run with the Python standard library only.

nodes.name: C002
nodes.rule: MCP server mode must degrade gracefully when the optional mcp package is missing.

nodes.name: C003
nodes.rule: Rollback may restore generated map projections only and must never revert source code.

nodes.name: C004
nodes.rule: CLI stdout and stderr must use UTF-8 with replacement-safe error handling.
